metadata.name: Hierarchy
metadata.description: Who reports to whom among your agents: an org chart you draw. It groups tasks by team (the «by team» lens, which can be turned off) and gives escalation its chain — a blocker its owner can't clear is asked upwards, one step at a time, before it reaches you. A reporting line grants no access and no authority: nobody commands anybody for sitting above them.

relations.name: reports_to
relations.description: Each agent reports to at most one; no cycles. The owner writes it on the silo's page.
